newsitem.title: USA: Uruguayan refinery unit shut for maintenance.
newsitem.headline: Uruguayan refinery unit shut for maintenance.

text.p: Uruguay's state oil company ANCAP has shut down the topping unit at its 34,600 barrels per day (bpd) La Teja refinery for scheduled maintenance, a trade source said on Thursday.
The unit was shut down on August 10 and is expected to be down until August 20, the source said.
As a result of the shutdown, ANCAP postponed a tender to buy one million barrels of crude for October 1-10 arrival. The tender was expected to be issued on August 8.
The tender may now be issued on August 15.
Separately, ANCAP plans to award a tender for gas oil on August 15.
